headerPolicy: Every adapted file carries an inline attribution block pointing at the pin, copyright, and license file. Orca's source for the Grab Mode guest overlay is a self-contained JS string template; Nexus ports the algorithm to TypeScript module functions integrated into its existing preload overlay, so entries are type 'adapted' rather than 'copied'. Existing copyright notices inside copied code are preserved.

files.changeSummary: Incremental unique-selector strategy ported from Orca's Grab Mode guest overlay to TypeScript module functions (buildSelector, selectorPartFor, stableClasses, isUniqueSelector, nthOfTypeSuffix, looksHashy, UNSTABLE_CLASS_PATTERN). Orca emits a JS string injected via executeJavaScript; Nexus keeps its preload overlay architecture and adopts only the selector-construction logic, adapted to this project's secret redaction (redactBrowserText) and the isSensitive allowIds gate. A simple-css-ident id still resolves to '#id' (fast path, parity with prior behavior/tests). Produces shorter, more robust selectors by preferring stable class names over generated/hashed ones and only adding :nth-of-type when the partial selector is not yet unique.
